typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	hasErrored as boolean (),
	WcfErrorMsg as string ()
}

source(output(
		MDCurveId as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT MDCurveId  FROM [Staging].[UserDefinedCurveTransform]  WHERE [Status]=\'Loaded Curve\' AND MDCurveId IS NOT NULL AND Error IS NULL GROUP BY MDCurveId',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetMDCurveIdsfromstaging	source(output(
		id as long,
		curveId as long,
		versionNumber as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Curves.Version',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupVersionLKPTABLE
GetMDCurveIdsfromstaging,LookupVersionLKPTABLE lookup(MDCurveId == curveId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupVersion
LookupVersion filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupVersion
FilterLookupVersion derive(Version = 1) ~> AddVersion1
AddVersion1 sink(input(
		curveId as long,
		versionNumber as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		curveId = MDCurveId,
		versionNumber = Version)) ~> CurvesVersion
